description: Retrieve the USPTO file-wrapper documents (office actions, responses, amendments, IDS, notices) for a US patent or application. Free. Returns each document's ID, mail date, category, and short description — IDs can be passed to `oa_analyze` for AI analysis.

applicationNumber.description: USPTO application number (e.g. 15912345). One of patentNumber or applicationNumber required.

patentNumber.description: Patent publication number (e.g. US10867416B2). One of patentNumber or applicationNumber required.

name: prosecution

documents.description: File-wrapper documents (document ID, mail date, category, description).
